firstLift.note: Facebook, 10 November 2025: "OPENING AT 3PM!!! ... the start of the 25/26 Trollhaugen Season is finally here". Preseason hours 3-8pm, Nissebakken and Tomtebakken park on Chair 3 plus rope; no rentals, no lessons, no beginner terrain.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 22 November 2025: "NORMAL HOURS BEGIN 11/28". Rentals, ski shop, snack bar and lounge from 11/28; Chair 2 and Storebakken/Minibakken added for Thanksgiving weekend. Closed 11/24-11/27 to make snow. Lessons lagged to 12/1.

firstLift.note: Facebook, 1 December 2023, same day: "Buck Hill is NOW OPEN for the 2023-2024 season!" Confirms the announcement on buckhill.com/opening-friday-dec-1st.

fullOps.note: Opened at full operations. buckhill.com/opening-friday-dec-1st lists 13 of 16 trails, both terrain parks, and the new Center Chair plus North Chair, Red Tail rope tow and both carpets, from day one.

firstLift.note: Reported by the author from Buck Hill’s Facebook feed, 25 August 2026. Archive agrees it was shut on 2 November ("OPENING FOR WINTER 2024-2025 AS WEATHER ALLOWS", all days Closed).

fullOps.note: Reported by the author from Buck Hill’s Facebook feed, 25 August 2026. Note a later blog post dated 23 December 2024 titled "BUCK HILL IS 100% OPEN!", which may mark the last trails rather than full operations — unresolved.

firstLift.note: cmskiarea.com WP post 9 Dec 2022, "22/23 SEASON OPENING DAY! 12/10/22": "open Saturday Dec 10th and Sunday Dec 11th, 10am-4pm. Singing Hill open with 2 lines of terrain park features. Only running the handle tow." Announced one day ahead; posts on 15 Dec about weekend hours and a weather closure confirm the season had started, and no correction was posted.

cmskiarea.com WP posts 12-13 Jan 2024: "BE CLOSED Saturday Jan 13th... Going to Try to be Open Sunday and Monday Jan 14th and 15th with limited operating hours and runs." A remarkably late start after "still currently closed" (9 Dec) and "Waiting for Cold" (28 Dec). This hill posts its changes, including the 13 Jan cancellation, and no further slip was posted; 18 Jan and 1 Feb posts confirm operation.

cmskiarea.com WP post 2 Dec 2024: "WE ARE OPENING!!! SATURDAY AND SUNDAY, DECEMBER 7th-8th, 11am-7pm." Announced five days ahead; the 9 Dec post giving 13-15 Dec hours confirms operation continued and no correction was posted.

cmskiarea.com WP post 3 Dec 2025: "OPEN THIS WEEKEND DECEMBER 13th and 14th, 10am-5pm... both lifts running which equals more runs." Announced ten days ahead; 15 Dec holiday-hours and 28 Dec open posts confirm operation, no correction posted.
